{{Quote|Stay on target.|[[Davish Krail/Legends|Davish "Pops" Krail]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Gold Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by [[Davish Krail/Legends|Davish "Pops" Krail]] when he flew with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CCGP">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Pops}}</ref>

Though a highly-experienced veteran [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Pops was no match for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and was killed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] along with [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]] and [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander/Legends|Dutch Vander]] in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]'', [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] refers to pilot [[Talos Merkin]] as Gold Five during the Battle of Yavin,<ref name="CtE">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref> though previous<ref name="CCGP" /> and subsequent<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|351|Gold Five}}</ref> sources affirm that Krail was Gold Five at the time.
